# AXE2 interface control document (generated by rf2/rf2_icd.py; MODELED)

Chassis v2 (rf2_chassis.py). 13 interfaces. Connector parts marked TBD carry the requirement they must meet; the readiness gate P0.1 stays open until every part is verified.

## Checks

- PASS: rule 6: every HV conductor insulated >= 630 V
- PASS: ampacity and pin counts
- PASS: harness nets in rf2_system all defined at an ICD joint (I2 head gland, I3b TXD pod tap, I5 hinge)
- PASS: head gland Y5B ZIFs: every LV net of I2 on a pin; VIN_H per pin and 29.4 V within the Y5B ratings (0.5 A, 50 V)
- PASS: screen FPC bend limit (3 bends) handled by a dynamic hinge flex (I11) and a static panel FPC (I12)
- PASS: every connector part verified (datasheet on file, ratings read)

## I1. Coil leads -> TXJ (head)

- **From / to:** coil (26 t FEP litz) -> TXJ
- **Medium:** litz ends into wire-hole pads, potted
- **Connector:** solder (wire-hole pads), existing TXJ board
- **Status:** built (board:TXJ)

## I2. Cord head end -> TXJ / CB1D / AB1A (head gland)

- **From / to:** cord flex piece 1 -> TXJ (TX pair), CB1D (power, link, TX command), AB1A (REF pairs)
- **Medium:** flex ends straight into the boards inside the gland (no pigtails), potted strain relief
- **Connector:** TXJ: TX strips soldered to the existing pads (no connector on HV); CB1D: Panasonic Y5B 10-way ZIF AYF531035 (VIN_H / GND_H on 2 pins each; 0.5 A / pin, 50 V, datasheet on file); AB1A: Panasonic Y5B 10-way ZIF AYF531035 (3 REF pairs + drain + REF guard); flex ends stiffened to the 0.30 mm applicable FPC thickness (owner 2026-10-31, option 'gland_fpc'; was JST GH 8-way + 7-way with flex-to-wire pigtails)
- **Status:** design

## I3. Cord flex through the telescope (head -> TXD pod tap -> REF3T -> hinge cord board; owner 2026-10-30 / 2026-10-31, HANDOFF 45 / 56)

- **From / to:** head gland -> TXD pod (TX), cord board in the hinge knuckle
- **Medium:** single-layer 2 oz long flex (rf2_cordflex): piece 1 18.24 mm wide: TX strips 3.22 mm with 1.0 mm rule-6 gaps (head -> pod tap only), VIN_H / GND_H, 3 diff pairs (TXCMD, TXSTAT, DATA), a 0.5 mm REF guard, 3 guarded REF pairs, a rolling loop for the 550 mm travel; piece 2 (REF3T -> hinge, static) 7.68 mm: HV_CLAMP / GND_CLAMP (rule-6 gap), VIN_T / GND_T, VIN_H / GND_H, DATA
- **Connector:** none on the TX strips (soldered at the gland board and the pod tap); REF3T and the cord board soldered; vendor: Tech Etch long flex (40 in preferred) or Minco (to 5 ft), capability on file; insulation: Kapton / acrylic coverlay 3500 V/mil and 1000 VRMS typical withstand (Minco design guide 2019, on file), the drawing calls a net-to-net hipot >= 1000 VRMS (rule 6: 630 V)
- **Status:** spec (roadmap P4.2: flex drawing + rolling-loop mock-up)

## I5. Hinge pass-through (cord board -> chassis)

- **From / to:** cord board (hinge knuckle) -> PWR (pod feed, clamp return) and HB2-M (DATA, VIN_H)
- **Medium:** clock-spring flex in the hollow hinge axis: unbonded single-sided plies (air-gap), 2 oz copper; HV_CLAMP >= 1.0 mm from everything (rule 6); 180 deg fold (no TX pair here since the TXD moved to the pod, 2026-10-31)
- **Connector:** Panasonic Y5B FPC ends (50 V, 0.5 A / pin, datasheet on file) on the LV ply (VIN_H, GND_H, DATA); the HV / power ply (HV_CLAMP, GND_CLAMP, VIN_T, GND_T) soldered to PWR and the cord board
- **Status:** design (P3.3)
